scene.backdrop: an ordinary, fictional, non-identifiable classroom with a worn teacher desk

subjects.description: anonymous adult teacher approaching from behind

composition.spatial_placement: teacher in the right third; clean tumbler on the lower-left desk

readable text, logos, minors, visible faces or extra hands
dramatic cinematic lighting, shallow depth of field or artificial bokeh
